name: Peeled Boiled Rutabaga Mash
whyItWorks: Waxed outer skin peeled away deeply, cubed, boiled in salted water until soft, and mashed with olive oil or ghee. A satisfying low-FODMAP earthy alternative to potatoes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel deeply with a paring knife past the wax coating into pale flesh. Dice small, boil for 25 minutes until crushable with a fork, and mash smooth with olive oil and salt.
